test_title: PYST 26: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Morning)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship between the following classes/categories.

Cardamom, Cashew, Spices
solution:
Venn diagram according to the given information is:

Cardamom, Cashew, Spices 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0542b60438f83ad429458393bd4affd2bf0465b892f0784ab6d8e148ebedb0ab.png] 

All cardamom comes in spices but cashew is not a spice but a dry fruit.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• With an estimated production volume of over three million metric tons, the **state of Madhya Pradesh was the largest producer of spices across India in 2020.** Rajasthan and Gujarat were the other major producers that year.
 
• **India is the world's largest producer, consumer, and exporter of spices**; the country produces about 75 of the 109 varieties listed by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) and accounts for half of the global trading in spices.
 
• **Kerala is the largest producer of small cardamom**, followed by Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.
 
• It may be observed that **Maharashtra **was the leading producer of cashew nuts followed by **Andhra Pradesh.**
